description: Update an existing pricing package on a Stay. Supplying 'prices' replaces ALL price rows for that package. Requires an MCP agent token scoped to the owning account.

advertisingEndpoint.description: OPTIONAL: only usable on Advertising-business-model Stays — ignored otherwise, matching the host UI which hides this field for all other business models.

endDate.description: OPTIONAL: last check-in date this package is available for

isActive.description: OPTIONAL: archive (false) or restore (true) this package — cascades to 'listed' on all its price tiers, matching the host UI's Archive/Restore actions

prices.description: OPTIONAL: replaces ALL price rows for this package when supplied. Exactly one entry per 7/14/21/30-night tier used.

buyPrice.description: Internal cost basis. SellPrice is NOT settable — always server-computed from buyPrice

days.description: Length-of-stay tier in nights — must be one of 7, 14, 21, 30

startDate.description: OPTIONAL: first check-in date this package is available for

stayRoomFK.description: The specific room this package covers (tbStaysRoom.EntryID). Call getMyStayRooms to find valid values.

name: updateStayPackage
